verses.pali: “Sabrahmakāni, bhikkhave, tāni kulāni yesaṁ puttānaṁ mātāpitaro ajjhāgāre pūjitā honti.
verses.english: “Mendicants, a family where the children honor their parents in their home is said to live with divinity.

verses.pali: Sapubbācariyakāni, bhikkhave, tāni kulāni, yesaṁ puttānaṁ mātāpitaro ajjhāgāre pūjitā honti.
verses.english: A family where the children honor their parents in their home is said to live with the first tutors.

verses.pali: Sapubbadevatāni, bhikkhave, tāni kulāni yesaṁ puttānaṁ mātāpitaro ajjhāgāre pūjitā honti.
verses.english: A family where the children honor their parents in their home is said to live with the elder gods.

verses.pali: Sāhuneyyakāni, bhikkhave, tāni kulāni yesaṁ puttānaṁ mātāpitaro ajjhāgāre pūjitā honti.
verses.english: A family where the children honor their parents in their home is said to live with those worthy of offerings dedicated to the gods.
‘Divinity’ is a term for your parents.
‘First tutors’ is a term for your parents.
‘Elder gods’ is a term for your parents.
‘Worthy of an offering dedicated to the gods’ is a term for your parents.

verses.pali: Bahukārā, bhikkhave, mātāpitaro, puttānaṁ āpādakā posakā imassa lokassa dassetāroti.
verses.english: Parents are very helpful to their children, they raise them, nurture them, and show them the world.
They’re worthy of offerings dedicated to the gods <j>from their children,
would revere them and honor them
they’re praised in this life by the astute,
and they depart to rejoice in heaven.”
